narr: Scattered thunderstorms just north of a frontal boundary produced heavy rain which caused flash flooding across portions of central Virginia.
ev: Flooded roads were reported at the intersection of McCloy Street and West Cary Street.
Flash flooding was reported near the intersection of Belt Boulevard and Hull Street Road.
Standing water was reported at the intersection of Flinn Lane and West Creek Road.
Route 636 was closed due to high water from the Buckingham/Cumberland county line east to Cedar Lane.
